notes: Image-only PDF (OCR source): all 7 page images viewed and every published row (193) compared by eye with items.csv on serving, kcal, protein, carbs, fat, sat fat, sodium, salt, sugars and fibre (kJ is not published): no value differs, including the 14 cells the script fixes by hand (decimal points the OCR lost). The re-run from the OCR cache reproduces items.csv byte for byte. Allergens: none published (link-only), nothing to verify. 5 newly held back because the table contradicts itself: Burger Buddies - Big King and Wellington Wagyu (salt vs sodium), Cheesecake Bar - Gooey Salted Caramel (kcal 285 vs macros 234, per 100 g fat says 14.7 g not 8.7 g), Vanilla Milkshake 16oz (sugars 0.7 g vs 12 g per 100 g of 510 g), Wagyu Patty (protein 24 g equals its per 100 g figure for a 125 g patty). burger_king.py now writes holdback.csv itself (it was hand-kept). Left published although the page's per 100 g rows disagree with the per-serving rows (per-serving row is self-consistent): Whopper fibre, Truffle Loaded Fries sugars, Chicken Nuggets 20pc, Halloumi Fries, Sharer Box S&C, Salted Caramel Milkshake 22oz, Sundae Salted Caramel. Fibre above carbohydrate on 5 trace/plant rows is left (UK tables often give available carbohydrate). Page 4 'Chilli Cheese Bites 20pc' 106 kcal stays held.
